title: Route flexibility analysis
author: Matt Bhagat-Conway
---

We allow up to 5 minutes of flexibility for desired arrivals/departures, if the flexibility will improve overall travel time by at least 15 minutes. This notebook looks at how this affects routing.

```{julia}
using DataFrames, GeoDataFrames, CSV, DataFramesMeta, Plots, Dates, StatsBase

const TBI_DIR = "/mnt/c/Users/mwbc/University of Kentucky/VMT Reduction Mode Shift - General/Data_Processed"
const DATA_DIR = "/home/mwbc/vmt-output"

const REPRESENTATIVE_WEEK = Date(2019, 10, 19)
select_representative_date(date) = Dates.tonext(x -> dayofweek(x) == dayofweek(date), REPRESENTATIVE_WEEK)
```

```{julia}
tbi = CSV.read(joinpath(TBI_DIR, "tbi_cleaned.csv"), DataFrame);
transit_trips = GeoDataFrames.read(joinpath(DATA_DIR, "transit_flexibility_applied_10k.parquet"));
```

```{julia}
single_trips = @chain transit_trips begin
    groupby(:trip_id)
    @combine(:start_time = first(:start_time), :end_time = last(:end_time))
    leftjoin(tbi, on=:trip_id)
end

single_trips.depart_date_time = DateTime.(select_representative_date.(single_trips.travel_date), single_trips.depart_time)
single_trips.arrive_date_time = DateTime.(select_representative_date.(single_trips.travel_date), single_trips.arrive_time)

single_trips.arrive_date_time[single_trips.arrive_time .< single_trips.depart_time] .+= Day(1)

single_trips.reverse_search = single_trips.d_purpose_category .== "Work" .&& single_trips.o_purpose_category .!= "Work"

single_trips.wait_time_seconds = Dates.value.(Second.(ifelse.(
    single_trips.reverse_search,
    single_trips.arrive_date_time .- single_trips.end_time,
    single_trips.start_time .- single_trips.depart_date_time
)))
```

# Wait time analysis

Most trips should wait a positive amount, but a few trips (less than 10%) violate constraints and wait a negative amount. For arrive-by trips, waiting is at the destination.

```{julia}
histogram(min.(single_trips.wait_time_seconds ./ 60, 240), legend=false, xlabel = "Wait time (minutes)", ylabel="Frequency")
```

The most they can violate constraints should be five minutes.

```{julia}
@assert minimum(single_trips.wait_time_seconds) ≥ -300
```

Less than 12% should violate constraints.

```{julia}
# what proportion of trips violated the constraints
# Based on previous analysis, should be <12%
mean(single_trips.wait_time_seconds .< 0)
```

There should be trips that violate constraints both for arrive-by and depart-at trips, and probably a similar number.

```{julia}
@chain single_trips begin
    groupby(:reverse_search)
    @combine :mean_violate_constraints = mean(:wait_time_seconds .< 0)
end
```
